title: Practical UAE With Strong Confidentiality and Integrity
summary: The authenticated-encryption construction lacks strongest confidentiality and the RLWE construction has relaxed integrity; the unresolved task is a practical UAE scheme meeting both strongest notions.

formal_statement.body: A practical updatable authenticated encryption (UAE) scheme is sought that simultaneously satisfies the strongest confidentiality and strongest integrity definitions. The authenticated-encryption-based construction provides security guarantees sufficient for typical updatable-encryption use cases but does not satisfy the strongest confidentiality definition, while the RLWE-based construction satisfies only a relaxed integrity notion. The unresolved task is therefore to construct a practical UAE scheme that meets both strongest notions simultaneously.

scope.domain: Design of cryptographic primitives, specifically practical updatable authenticated encryption schemes and their confidentiality and integrity notions.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a practical UAE scheme that simultaneously satisfies the strongest confidentiality and strongest integrity definitions.

citations.label: Improving Speed and Security in Updatable Encryption Schemes

progress.summary: The source presents this as the first of two open problems for future work. It contrasts the authenticated-encryption-based and RLWE-based constructions, then asks for a practical UAE scheme satisfying both strongest definitions.
